items.title: Charlie De Vore Interview, 1962-07-04
items.q: we're recording today at 731 St. Peter Street, Donald Russell's record shop, home of American Music Records.

ctx.x: I'll start it out formally by saying we're recording today at 731 St. Peter Street, Donald Russell's record shop, home of American Music Records. What's today's date?
4th of July. It's Armstrong's birthday. Look out for the bird.
